item.title: Cuba says 8 World Baseball Classic delegation members denied US visas
item.description: Cuba is set to play against Puerto Rico, Colombia, Panama and Canada in San Juan.

item.title: Kurtenbach: Mock this — I’m planting a flag on who the 49ers should draft in the first round
item.description: This under-the-radar prospect is exactly who the Niners need in the 2026 NFL Draft.

item.title: Monterey County jury awards $18 million to Rhode Island woman after being struck by state vehicle
item.description: “The jury found that the state failed to properly train and supervise this individual, and that failure resulted in devastating, lifelong consequences.”

item.title: NTSB chair slams House aviation bill as ‘watered-down’ after 67 deaths near Washington
item.description: Jennifer Homendy said the House bill’s “watered-down” requirements wouldn’t do enough to prevent a tragedy.

item.title: SF Giants observations: Tidwell continues impressing, Birdsong struggles again
item.description: Blade Tidwell allowed two runs over two innings but induced nine swings-and-misses

item.title: Republican voter ID bill stalls in Senate despite Trump demands
item.description: Thune says he supports the legislation and his conference is discussing how to pass it.

item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Maduro's attorney says the U.S. government violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds.

item.title: CIF State wrestling: Four county wrestlers advance to quarterfinals
item.description: Palma's Aiden Garcia, Alvarez's Jacob Perez, and Alisal's Fabian Martinez and Areli Rodriguez all advance to the CIF State wrestling quarterfinals after winning their first two matches Thursday.

item.title: CCS girls basketball playoffs: Fourth quarter magic lifts Palma into Division V finals
item.description: Palma is headed to the CCS Division V girls basketball finals, rallying in the fourth quarter for a 41-34 win over Crystal Springs Upland

item.title: CCS boys basketball playoffs: Palma downs Pinewood, returning to Division V finals
item.description: Palma is headed to the CCS Division V finals; Pacific Grove falls in the Division IV semifinals
